abstract: How to get, filter, and save logs and crash reports from Capacitor apps on iOS Simulator, iPhone, Android emulator, and devices. Explains that Capacitor's iOS bridge and mirrored JS console output is stdout-only (Xcode console, simctl launch --console-pty, devicectl process launch --console) while os.Logger goes to the unified log (Console.app, log stream, log collect --device-udid); Android Capacitor and Capacitor/Console logcat tags, crash buffer, Android Studio Logcat queries, tombstones, ANRs and bugreports. Includes verified Xcode 27 command syntax and error fixes.
